opportunities.title: Synthesis Grants

amount.raw: Synthesis groups can claim up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must have BES membership; not required for all working group members. Groups of 8-15 individuals with a diverse mix of career stages, institutions and international participation, demonstrating EDI.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by funding the formation of new two-year synthesis groups (8-15 participants) that bring together diverse interdisciplinary groups to analyse and synthesise existing data.

opportunities.title: Long-term Research Grants

amount.raw: £3,500 claimable in year 1 (first five years' worth), additional £3,500 in year 6; averages £500 a year over a decade.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners (e.g. Reserve Managers, consultants) and university academics. Awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding over 10 years for long-term ecological studies anywhere in the world, funding a few days of data gathering per year to enable short-term projects with 1-2 years of data to be funded into the long term.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical Research and Development Grants

amount.raw: Projects can be awarded up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level (early years to lifelong learning, formal or informal). Awarded to individuals, not organisations. Projects max 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Funds research on education methods within ecology to improve teaching and learning practices, improve learner experience and promote excellence in teaching, providing up to £5k towards evidence-based learning.

opportunities.title: Connecting Ecologists with Other Disciplines Grants

amount.raw: Grant awards of up to £20,000 can be claimed from the applicant.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers or employees of other organisations. Undergraduates and masters students not eligible. Awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Promoting interdisciplinary skills by funding up to £20k towards placements (secondments) in different disciplines and sectors, immersing an ecologist in another professional world where ecology can make a difference. Placements up to 12 months.

opportunities.title: Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Funding provided for researchers from all countries globally; projects can be conducted anywhere in the world. Not a scholarship; cannot fund work forming part of a funded fellowship or completing an undergraduate/masters degree.
opportunities.summary: Providing up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard, with a clear ecological science focus.

opportunities.title: Outreach and Engagement Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership. Open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels. Projects max 12 months; must target a non-academic audience.
opportunities.summary: Providing funding of up to £2,000 for individuals, teams and organisations to engage public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science and careers.

opportunities.title: Training and Travel Grants

amount.raw: A maximum of £250 for virtual conferences/courses; a maximum of £500 for in-person events.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member and a PhD student or postgraduate researcher (PGR) registered on a postgraduate research degree programme. Postdocs, undergraduates and masters students not eligible. Must work/study at a university or research institution.
opportunities.summary: Helps PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses and travel costs associated with presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member at any career stage; must be a citizen of and based in the Global South; must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting; must be at least three years since last awarded a BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting 2026 in the UK, covering travel and costs directly related to attending the meeting.
